span.p:
prometheus-model-{short_id}
FROM python:3.11-slim
Built on-the-fly by Harbor
Installed:
fastapi, uvicorn
onnxruntime
numpy, pandas
prometheus-client
scikit-learn, joblib
Port: auto (starting 8080)
Restart: unless-stopped

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FastAPI App:
POST /predict → ONNX inference
GET /health → readiness
GET /metrics → Prometheus
Preprocessing config loaded
from model_preprocess.json
Fallback: pickle if ONNX fails

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Drift Monitor Loop
PSI check every hour
Threshold: 0.2
On alert → DRIFT_ALERT event
